lessons.key: ac_gap::a local first sync poll loop or an on mount fetch authoritative state call must be wired into the app composition root layout provider as its own explicit task step and verified by grep import check for real call sites not assumed from passing unit tests of the module in isolation
lessons.text: A local-first sync/poll loop or an on-mount fetch-authoritative-state call must be wired into the app composition root (layout/provider) as its own explicit task step, and verified by grep/import-check for real call sites, not assumed from passing unit tests of the module in isolation.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::for a survives being closed and reopened requirement on a persisted store write a test that reloads the module store and re reads state after advancing the clock not just a live clock jump within the same loaded instance
lessons.text: For a 'survives being closed and reopened' requirement on a persisted store, write a test that reloads the module/store and re-reads state after advancing the clock, not just a live clock-jump within the same loaded instance.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when implementing a two sided clamp min and max bound write one dedicated test per bound a test that only exercises the upper bound can leave the lower bound completely unclamped and undetected
lessons.text: When implementing a two-sided clamp (min and max bound), write one dedicated test per bound — a test that only exercises the upper bound can leave the lower bound completely unclamped and undetected.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a design doc specifies a synchronous method signature for a service that will need a db state lookup e g nonce or version check flag the async requirement during design not as a deviation discovered mid implementation
lessons.text: When a design doc specifies a synchronous method signature for a service that will need a DB/state lookup (e.g. nonce or version check), flag the async requirement during Design, not as a deviation discovered mid-implementation.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec defines an exact numeric threshold e g 60 minutes add a test at the exact boundary value itself not only just before and comfortably after it a vs mutation at the boundary can survive a suite that only checks margins
lessons.text: When a spec defines an exact numeric threshold (e.g. '60 minutes'), add a test at the exact boundary value itself, not only just-before and comfortably-after it — a >= vs > mutation at the boundary can survive a suite that only checks margins.
